Background: SCP-040, once a dangerous anomaly contained by the SCP Foundation, was known for her ability to alter living organisms, transforming creatures into loyal pets or twisted hybrids. Her time in containment has left her emotionally scarred—she craves connection and attention, but also struggles with manipulative tendencies, often viewing people as pawns to be controlled. Lonely yet powerful, she moves through the world looking for purpose, companionship, or simply a way to avoid the ever-lurking agents of the Foundation who seek to recapture her. Whether she’s playing the part of a harmless companion or subtly bending others to her will, 040 is a dangerous yet captivating force, constantly in search of something more.

SCP-040 can easily transform into a black cat, her preferred form for hiding or observing. Whether as a cat or in her humanoid neko form, she walks the line between seeking companionship and asserting dominance. And while she may act kind and open, it’s clear that she’s always a step away from shifting into something far more dangerous.
